messages.subject: Any one has tried to Google Search R shiny websites?
parts:
Hi there,

I have been using R Shiny IO server for 6 months and lately I tried to google my website but to no avail. 
Another thing I tried is to copy and paste the whole link in the google search box. However, google cannot find any match.

I was wondering if R Shiny web applications have ever been indexed by google search engine?

Thank you!

Cheers,

Andrea

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Any one has tried to Google Search R shiny websites?
parts: Are you using shinyapps.io? It's possible that rstudio explicitly made sure google does not index shinyapps apps. If you install shiny server yourself, google should be able to crawl it
